name: sales_call
description: What a recorded sales call can state: one simple fact per thing said, about the deal, the people, the account, and the commitments and objections it opens. Status is never extracted; aggregation derives it. Tuned on a set of recorded discovery and demo calls.

deal.description: A sales opportunity, by its CRM id: deal:hs-<id>.

pain.description: a problem the prospect has today

desired_outcome.description: something they want to achieve; keep the figures and examples the speaker names

close_rate.description: their current close rate, with what it measures

price_quoted.description: a price we quoted (one fact per bound of a range)

decision_criterion.description: something they will judge vendors on

decision_maker.description: a person who takes part in the final decision (not someone only gathering information for the deciders); a name with role if not on the call; a person's id from the call, or their name and role

economic_buyer.description: the person who controls budget or signs; a person's id from the call, or their name and role

advocate.description: a prospect who says they want this or will push for it

competitor.description: another vendor in play for this need

current_tool.description: a tool they use today relevant to the deal, including in-house tools and home-built attempts that failed; keep the key specifics

decision_date.description: when they say they will decide

compelling_event.description: an event or deadline that creates urgency

requirement.description: a capability they need from us; one fact per item when they list several, with the reason when they give one

next_meeting.description: the date of the next meeting they agreed

decision_process_step.description: how the group decides or who must see what, e.g. 'both co-founders sign off; finance reviews the contract first'

top_rep_sales.description: sales by their best rep in the stated period, e.g. top rep closed $400k last quarter

capability_claimed.description: something we said our product can do in answer to a prospect question, with how, e.g. 'CRM stage changes via API, human approves each write'

next_meeting_detail.description: time, timezone, purpose or invitees of the agreed next meeting, e.g. '11:00 AM Central', 'pricing walkthrough; Dana adds her ops lead'

scheduling_constraint.description: a stated reason a date does not work or someone is unavailable, e.g. 'Dana at a trade show until the 14th'

pricing_model.description: how we said pricing is structured or given, e.g. 'per user per month', 'verbal range, flexible'

account.description: The prospect's company, by its CRM id.

product_line.description: a line of business, including the business mix ('mostly commercial accounts') and lines they no longer sell

team_count.description: number of sales teams the reps are split into

current_process.description: one step of how they onboard, train or coach reps today, e.g. 'two weeks shadowing a senior rep before taking calls'

sales_language.description: a language their reps sell in

contact.description: A person at the prospect, by CRM id or email.

title.description: job title; a stated future title gets valid_from on its start date

location.description: where the person is, if stated

tenure.description: how long the person has been at the company or in the industry, one fact each

scope.description: what the person leads or is responsible for, in their words, e.g. 'runs the regional managers'

commitment.description: Something someone promised on the call. An item: the engine names it commitment:<episode>#<n>.

action.description: something either side promised or offered to do (e.g. 'offered to send a sample rollout plan'), including what the prospect says they will do

owner.description: a person's id from the call, or their name and role

objection.description: A concern the prospect raised. An item: the engine names it objection:<episode>#<n>.

concern.description: a concern or doubt the prospect raises, including doubts phrased as questions (setup effort, seat flexibility) and stated risks

raised_by.description: a person's id from the call, or their name and role

response.description: the answer we gave to this concern, e.g. 'setup takes under a day'; not whether it resolved it

meeting.description: This call, by its meeting id.

shown.description: one thing we demonstrated, keeping specifics such as the scenario, figures, scores and named features

invited.description: Written by the engine, not the model: calendar metadata, not extraction.

attended_by.description: Written by the engine, not the model: who spoke in the recording, not extraction.

scheduled_at.description: Written by the engine, not the model: when the call took place. Its title is its name.

rep.description: One of our sales people, by email.

title.description: one of our reps' role or title as stated on the call
